initiatives.name: The STAY Project
initiatives.description: Youth-led network for people ages 14-30 across Central and Southern Appalachia, based in New Market, Tennessee. Runs a summer institute, a member support fund, and community events.

initiatives.name: Kentuckians For The Commonwealth (KFTC)
initiatives.description: Statewide membership organization founded in 1981. Organizes on economic justice, climate and environment, voting rights, and racial justice across Kentucky.

initiatives.name: Kentucky Health Justice Network
initiatives.description: Funding abortion and gender-affirming care in Kentucky.

initiatives.name: Kentucky Legal Aid
initiatives.description: Free civil legal help for low-income, elderly, and disabled people in 35 counties of south-central and western Kentucky, including housing, benefits, family law, and domestic abuse cases.
